evidence_extensions.label: Push / Roll
evidence_extensions.why: Pushing or rolling an object without picking it up (e.g. rolling a ball through a gap) is not Pick / Place. The extension remains within Move & Arrange.

policy.primary: One dominant operation family/subtype per clip for a mutually exclusive census.
policy.additional: Only distinct, visibly supported and task-salient operations; not every reach/grasp used to perform another operation.
policy.paired_labels: Slash-separated labels name an operation group; they do not assert both actions occur.
policy.task_success: Operation labels do not declare task completion, calibration, atomic-event boundaries or physical correctness.
policy.evidence: Labels are assigned from the caption, the task text and sampled RGB frames; sampled frames are not an exhaustive frame-by-frame review of the video.

subtypes.definition: Grasp, lift, carry or place a whole object; placement success is not implied.
Whole-object hand-to-hand or agent-to-agent handover, not a spoon moving loose contents.
Select, group, order, stack or align multiple whole items; no exact sorted count is implied.
Reorient or reposition a whole object in hand, including deliberate regrasping; not turning a device joint.
Evidence-based extension: deliberate non-prehensile whole-object pushing, rolling or flicking.
Reshape flexible material by folding, bending, creasing, coiling or twisting; not articulated tool motion.
Material cutting, trimming, peeling, splitting or shape-changing pinching; excludes ordinary grasp pinches and scissors closing in empty air.
Needle/hook/yarn work along textile or stitch structures, including local stitching or unpicking; excludes merely holding loose cord.
Align or fit a part at an interface, insert or join components, including partial attempts; not ordinary storage placement.
Operate an identifiable fastener, nail or electrical plug; screwdriver presence alone is insufficient.
Cross, wind or adjust a retaining cord, tie, lace or binding; no completed knot is inferred.
Open, close or locally attempt a closure/lid/package; an already-open package held for inspection is not opening.
Operate controls, rotate articulated parts or make visible local fine adjustments through turning/pressing; does not infer a hidden completed join.
Slide a mechanism, feed/draw a flexible length, turn pages, or unfold a pre-existing articulated/prefolded structure.
Move loose contents with a scoop/spoon or by tilting a container; not moving an empty spoon as an object.
Sprinkle, spray, pump or squeeze material out of a dispenser; dispensing amount or physical success is not inferred.
Move a utensil through contents with repeated stirring/mixing motions; no homogeneity claim.
Wipe, rub or brush a surface with hands, tissue, cloth or brush; cleanliness improvement is not implied.
Apply/spread a coating to a target surface; do not infer coating just from a held tube or background paint.
Abrasive surface finishing, filing, polishing or sharpening strokes; excludes nonabrasive ordinary wiping.
Present, inspect, read or visually document an object/label without asserting unseen mental attention or readable exact text.
Use measurement jaws or electrical/contact probes; mere generic tool contact does not establish measurement.
Make physical pen/marker marks; digital button/keyboard input is grouped under operating controls.
